name: Metoprolol
description: A cardioselective beta-1 adrenergic blocker approved for hypertension, angina and heart failure. Carries a boxed warning against abrupt discontinuation.

systems.note: Beta-1 adrenergic blockade reducing rate and contractility; the labelled indications.
Masks the adrenergic warning signs of hypoglycaemia and blunts the glycaemic recovery response.
Suppresses heart rate, so resting heart rate no longer reads as a fitness signal.

monitors.why: Masks the adrenergic warning signs of hypoglycaemia; labelled.
Beta blockade adversely affects the lipid panel.
